subject: Data Engineering
title: What Makes a Warehouse Different
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Makes a Warehouse Different.

hook.text: A warehouse looks like a database. It speaks SQL. But under the hood, everything is different.

buildup.text: Warehouses use columnar storage, massive parallelism, and query optimizers tuned for aggregation.

discovery.text: They trade write speed for read speed — slow to load, blazing fast to query.

twist.text: Running a transactional app on a warehouse would be painfully slow. They're not general-purpose.

climax.text: Warehouses are purpose-built machines: designed for one thing and exceptional at it.

punchline.text: Warehouses read fast because they sacrifice everything else.

quiz.question: What do warehouses optimize for compared to regular databases?
options: Read and query speed for analytics
